evidence: Documents tab lists all technical documents, each showing its module tag (e.g. API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System) with module filter buttons (All/API/AUTH/DATA/UI/CORE).
Selecting a document (e.g. REST API Design Guidelines) shows title, "Content Sections" with paragraphs, and a "Related Documents" list.
Clicking "API Versioning Strategy" reference link inside an expanded section navigated to that document's detail view; repeated with "REST API Guidelines" link successfully.
Clicking an expanded section header ("Versioning Approaches") hid its paragraph content, leaving only the header and reference links visible.
Re-clicking the collapsed section header restored the paragraph content.

Clicking graph nodes (e.g. "HTTP Methods Guide", "Rate Limiting") updates the app's selected document state (verified via localStorage/Documents tab); module legend with 5 color-coded modules is displayed alongside nodes.
Knowledge Graph view renders all 19 document nodes with zoom in/out and Reset View controls to view the graph in its entirety.
Top navigation has exactly three tabs: Documents, Knowledge Graph, Favorites.

Set REST API Design Guidelines section states (REST Principles collapsed, Endpoint Naming Conventions expanded) and graph zoom to 140%, switched tabs (Graph→Documents, Documents→Favorites) and back; both the section collapse states and 140% zoom level were retained. Confirmed via localStorage key "tech-docs-storage" persisting sectionStates and graphState.zoom.

Favorites stored in localStorage ("tech-docs-storage" -> favorites array); nav badge showed real-time count "Favorites 2" after adding 2 items; after filtering by "API" module and sorting by "Last Updated", the favorited items (Rate Limiting, REST API Design Guidelines) still displayed "Remove from favorites" state correctly.
Knowledge Graph tab shows an interactive node-link diagram with per-module coloring, zoom/pan, and clickable nodes representing documents.
Programmatically extracted all 19 documents' relatedDocs arrays from source data; none contained the document's own id (no self-references found).

Graph contains exactly 19 nodes, one per document in the dataset, and the module legend lists exactly the 5 modules (API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System) matching moduleInfo in the app data.

Source inspection of DocumentViewer's handleRelatedDocClick shows a guard: if getDocumentById(docId) returns null, it calls showToast('Related document not found','error') and returns without navigating/crashing. Toast rendering mechanism was independently confirmed working in the UI (e.g. "Please expand the section to access links" toast appeared when clicking a link in a collapsed section).
Expanded section's chevron icon has class "...rotate-180" (transform: matrix(-1,0,0,-1,0,0)); collapsed section's chevron has no rotate class (transform: none) — clear visual state indicator.

issue: Clicking a document node in the Knowledge Graph does not navigate the user to the Document View.
actual: Clicking a graph node (e.g. "HTTP Methods Guide", "Rate Limiting") updates the internally selected document, but the active tab remains "Knowledge Graph". The user must manually click the "Documents" tab afterward to see the document's view; there is no automatic navigation/tab switch to the document view upon node click.
evidence: After clicking "Rate Limiting" node, snapshot showed Knowledge Graph tab still active with graph unchanged; only after manually clicking "Documents" tab did the Rate Limiting document view appear.
